newsitem.title: GERMANY: DG Bank says Mobilcom greenshoe fully exercised.
newsitem.headline: DG Bank says Mobilcom greenshoe fully exercised.

text.p: Germany's DG Bank said in a statement on Monday that so-called "greenshoe options" on Mobilcom shares, the mobile phone service provider which went public earlier, had been fully exercised.
DG Bank says Mobilcom greenshoe fully exercised
The oversubscription allotment, or greenshoe option, of the Schleswig-based MobilCom, with a nominal value of 800,000 marks or 160,000 shares, was fully exercised.
Earlier the chief executive of Mobilcom, Gerhard Schmid, said the 640,000 shares to be floated in the company were more than 100 times oversubscribed.
After an initial offer of 62.50 marks, shares in the company were then officially quoted at 95 marks later on.
